functions.capability: Manual native tenant-admin UTC daily rollup.

advisor_assessment: All security and performance WARN/ERROR counts unchanged. Unused-index INFO count decreased from 926 to 925 after tests; retain required access indexes.
limits: Daily rollup is manual and scoped to one native active tenant admin and one UTC date. No global bucket or unattended scheduler is supported/enabled.
Usage, feedback and knowledge-gap reads share one SQL statement snapshot. Existing unique index plus per-org/day transaction lock and atomic upsert make reruns consistent and idempotent.
Day bounds are [UTC midnight,next UTC midnight), avoiding missing fractional-second events. Assistant data is read via same-org conversation joins without the source's 500-conversation mapping cap.

Missing/invalid/negative/oversized cost metadata produces null total/affected tier costs, cost_complete=false and unknown_cost_requests. Unknown tiers are counted separately; no-feedback satisfaction is null. Old rows default to unverified cost_complete=false; consumers must handle these fields/null costs before dashboard cutover.

Activity processing remains gated pending provider/model governance, authorized storage/transcript ownership, atomic result finalization and input/output validation. No file, transcript, email or organizational knowledge content is returned by preflight.

Every recording-based processing mode checks same-org ownership and consent; process/transcribe additionally enforce file-size/duration bounds. No provider request, recording status change, transcript, coaching review or audit content was created.
No real tenant rollup was executed; all data writes in tests rolled back. No hosted app update, main merge, schedule activation, final source delta or source retirement.
